properties.name: spring.batch.data.mongodb.isolation-level-for-create
properties.description: Transaction isolation level to use when creating job metadata for new jobs.

properties.name: spring.batch.data.mongodb.schema.initialize
properties.description: Whether to initialize the Spring Batch job repository schema in MongoDB.

properties.name: spring.batch.data.mongodb.schema.location
properties.description: Path to the newline-delimited JSON script used to create the Spring Batch job repository collections and indexes in MongoDB.

properties.name: spring.batch.data.mongodb.validate-transaction-state
properties.description: Whether to validate the transaction state.
